_meta.title: Continent 1 — EDU (Arcadia) designation pass: biomes · regions/gates · lore towns · ruins · monuments
_meta.author: CF ParcelMap Design Agent, 2026-10-27 — regenerate with map-service/tools/world_continent_edu.mjs (deterministic; builds twice + sha-compares)
_meta.idScheme: Keys of biomes/regions/gates and towns[].parcelId / pois[].parcelId are CF's ids = the OLD hexagon-city token id (tokenIdOld, `602…`) that data/demo-world.json + data/towns.json use. `parcelIdCurrent` / idMap give the CURRENT id (designer registry, world fields). Same 10-digit tail; only the leading size digit differs.
_meta.biomeRule: canon HexTerrain only; precedence ROAD > RIVER > MOUNTAIN > HILLS (rim terraces ≤4.5u, castle parcels) > PLAINS (towns, river basin, noise<0.5) > FOREST. EDU is an inland plateau: no COAST/OCEAN. A road over a river/ridge is ROAD (the bridge/pass = the gate parcel).
_meta.regionRule: bbox-touch adjacency cut by river/ridge bands → components; <40-parcel slivers fold into the neighbouring region; EDU-R<nn> numbered by smallest CF id. Gates: ROAD parcels a barrier crosses (bridge/pass); every touching region pair keeps ≥1 (narrowest cut edge → ford/scramble).
_meta.coords: EDU zone svg viewBox (0 0 155.77 148.06); y=0 edge faces HUB (north). Same space as data/hexagon-city-source/l3/EDU.json parcel centers/bboxes — clip features to a parcel bbox/polygon directly in these coords.

towns.name: First Question
towns.blurb: the crossroads where every scholar's road begins — ask, and the inn answers with tea

towns.name: Inkstone
towns.blurb: the quarry-town of the inkstone seams; its grey blocks face half the Academy's cloisters

towns.name: Bellterrace
towns.blurb: terraces under the rim where the Examination bell is heard first — rice, lamps and lodging

towns.name: Second Lesson
towns.blurb: the bridge-head market — timber down the Flow, iron up the terrace road, tolls both ways

towns.name: Chalkford
towns.blurb: the white ford on the West Tributary; carters rest here before the climb to Westgate

towns.name: Lamplight Row
towns.blurb: the study-lamp makers' street — oil, brass and the telepath circles' quiet trade

pois.name: the Broken Lectern
pois.inscription: Here the Second Age argued, and lost.

pois.name: the Drowned Library
pois.inscription: The water took the books; the lessons stayed.

pois.name: the Old Examination Hall
pois.inscription: No bell rang for the last class.

pois.name: the Unlit Beacon
pois.inscription: They watched the north until the north came.

pois.name: the Quarry Chapel
pois.inscription: Stone remembers the hands that cut it.

pois.name: the Fallen Torii
pois.inscription: Pass under, and leave your question.

pois.name: The Westgate Field

pois.name: The North Stele

pois.name: The Scholar's Cairn
